tasks.title: Harden /runtask and /runbatch against reports that are vacuous - and against agents that die with real work on disk and no report at all

THREE distinct report failures are now on record and the skills address none of them explicitly: (1) an agent returned outcome 'done' with evidence, verify_output and notes all set to the literal string 'test' - schema-valid, entirely empty; (2) an agent died on quota with nothing durable; (3) an agent died on quota with 315 lines of good work on disk, no report, no falsification, and a scratch file left behind.
